scaler_rule: Per-column float64 training-prefix mean and population std (ddof=0), std=max(std,1e-5); float32 input minus float64 mean divided by float64 std; clip [-8,8] then cast float32
scaler_fit_scope: Original train.csv rows [0,2526320), never final rows
row_order: Original train.csv rows followed by original final_test.csv rows, no sorting/deduplication
identity_hash_rule: SHA256 of contiguous little-endian signed int64 (<i8), no header, original train.csv then final_test.csv rows
availability: Same-day complete auxiliary news snapshot and unlabeled exposures, offline; history metadata strictly prior dates

input_provenance.oof_target_statistics: Existing duplicate-group five-fold OOF on all training dates; final encoded from all training labels
input_provenance.past_target_statistics: Existing full cache per-row strictly earlier dates; final uses only training dates

oof.hash_rule: SHA256 of complete NPY bytes including header

past.hash_rule: SHA256 of complete NPY bytes including header
